content_fields.title: Verify if message throttling is properly performed in Web APIs
content_fields.description: Apply the configured slowapi limiter to the routes it was introduced for so request throttling is actually enforced.
content_fields.finding: A slowapi Limiter is constructed with no default limits, and no route in the application applies @limiter.limit, so no API throttling is actually enforced.
content_fields.current_code:
from slowapi import Limiter
from slowapi.util import get_remote_address

limiter = Limiter(key_func=get_remote_address)
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/rate_limiting.py
from slowapi import Limiter
from slowapi.util import get_remote_address

limiter = Limiter(key_func=get_remote_address, default_limits=["120/minute"])

# app/apis/auth/services/get_token_service.py
@router.post("/token")
@limiter.limit("5/minute")
async def get_token(request: Request, ...):
    ...
criteria: The Limiter is constructed with a default limit.
Authentication, password-reset and admin routes carry an explicit, tighter @limiter.limit decorator.
Exceeding a limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.
